 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7782  CRL.P No. 101498 of 2024  THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard Smt.Jagadi Ashwini Shankar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. Kirtilata R. Patil,
learned HCGP for the respondent No.1-State.
Respondent No.1 served and unrepresented.

2. The petitioner/accused is seeking regular bail in Crime No.231/2023 of Khanapur Police Station,
pending on the file of Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC- 1, Belagavi for the offences punishable under Sections 366(A), 376 (2) (L), 376(3) of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC- 1, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Brief facts of the case:
3.

It is the case of the prosecution that the mother of the victim, lodged a complaint stating that on 01.10.2023 around 2.00 p.m., she has received an information from her son Srinath stating that her daughter Namita was suffering from stomach pain and she was NC: 2024:KHC-D:7782 asked to come immediately to the house.
She came to her house and on enquiry, she learnt that her daughter has been committed sexual assault by the petitioner.
Consequently, she sustained stomach pain.

Based on her complaint, the police have registered a case in crime No.231/2023 and conducted the investigation and submitted the charge sheet.
4.
It is the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and a complaint has been filed without verifying true facts.
There is a delay in lodging a complaint which creates doubt.
The investigation is completed and chargesheet is filed.
Though the victim is aged about 13 years, that is not the only ground to reject the bail petition.
5. It is further submitted that the petitioner is aged about 40 years and he is working as mason and he will abide the conditions imposed by this Court in the event of his release on bail.
Making such submission, the NC: 2024:KHC-D:7782 learned counsel for the petitioner prays to allow the petition.

Shri. Shahu S/O. Rama Gavade vs The State Of Karnataka on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188860871/
2 6.
Per contra, learned HCGP vehemently opposed the said bail petition and submitted that the act of the petitioner is barbaric and inhuman.
He being an aged person committed sexual assault on a minor girl which is heinous in nature and he is not entitled for any relief as prayed for.
Making such submission, the learned HCGP prays to dismiss the petition.

7. Having heard the learned counsel for respective parties and also perused the averments of the chargesheet, it appears from the record that the complainant and her husband were doing coolie work at Goa by leaving their children at their native.
The petitioner taking advantage of the absence of the complainant and her husband, enticing the victim girl and committed sexual assault which is heinous in nature.
The age of the victim as on the date of the incident was 13 years.

Having NC:
2024:KHC-D:7782 considered the act of the petitioner and also tender age of the victim, it is fit case to reject the bail.

8. Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition is rejected.

Sd/-
